name: Pokey Pixie Pinprick
description: No machine, one needle. Every line is a row of separate dots you could count, if you have the afternoon.

designs.title: Poked Heart
designs.description: A double-lined heart in single dots, half filled with an even grid of more dots.

designs.title: Moon and Pins
designs.description: A dotted crescent moon with a handful of tiny stars caught in its curve.

designs.title: Poked Dagger
designs.description: A little dagger with a ribbon wound round its blade, all dots, no solid line anywhere.

designs.title: Poked Bee
designs.description: A round bee with dotted wings and dense striped bands. Friendly, and only slightly lopsided.

designs.title: Poked Cherries
designs.description: A pair of cherries on one twig, with hand-poked shadow and a small shine on each.

designs.title: Nine Small Charms
designs.description: A page of nine tiny charms to pick from: heart, star, moon, dagger, flower, sun, skull, gem and bolt.
